## ⭐ I measured the fork before writing it down, and one branch of option ① is already dead

Triage's deliverable is **二选一, ⛔ 不是两者都做一半**. Here is what each option actually costs, measured rather than reasoned:

| branch | reading | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| ① via **a new dependency** — give `@object-ui/components` an `app-shell` dep | `packages/app-shell/package.json` **already declares `@object-ui/components: workspace:*`** (control: 48 deps total) | ⛔ **dead — it closes a cycle.** Do not attempt it. |
| ① via **`apps/console`** | `apps/console/package.json` declares **both** `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/components` at `workspace:*` (control: 61 deps total) | ✅ **viable** — a pin there can reach the writing end with no new edge |
| ② make the sentence true | prose in `PageView.tsx` | ✅ viable, and triage says it is *"not obviously worse"* |

⇒ The card's own lead — *"the correct end-to-end shape may already be measurable from `apps/console`"* — is **confirmed**, and the card was right to say ⛔ verify it rather than inherit it. I verified it; now verify me.

## ⚠️ Whichever option you take, four other citations must stay true

The pin is cited at **5** sites. The writing-end one is the false one; the others are the **reading-end** declarations the card says are correct — including `packages/types/src/registry.ts:192`, `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts:613` and `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx:748`. ⛔ Do not weaken or contradict them: the counter-ablation proved the pin genuinely guards the reading end (removing the `utility` registration turned it **RED 2/3**, naming the kind). Only the writing end is unguarded.

## The acceptance condition, and it is the same in both options

⭐ **The gutting ablation must flip.** Today, gutting `PageView`'s mapping to `type: 'page'` leaves the pin **GREEN 5/5** — that is the measurement that falsified the sentence.

- If you take ①: run that same ablation and show the new surface goes **RED**, naming what broke. A guard that cannot be shown failing is the defect this card is about, one layer out.
- If you take ②: the sentence must state what the ablation actually shows — the reading end is pinned, the writing end is not — and ⛔ must not promise any red that you have not demonstrated.

⛔ **Leaving a false guarantee is the worst outcome**, because it suppresses the check the next reader would otherwise make. That is triage's ruling and it is not mine to soften.

## ⛔ Hard constraints

- ⛔ **Do not touch objectui#9642 or PR objectui#9705.** The parent card is closed; this is its follow-up, not its re-litigation.
- ⛔ **Do not add an `app-shell` dependency to `@object-ui/components`** — measured above, it closes a cycle.
- ⛔ **Do not delete the pin** or narrow what it guards at the reading end.
- **Clause-②: `no`** — no exported symbol moves and no key is added to a published payload; a new test surface is not a published face. Re-measure at delivery and return it as a `clause_2` field; mechanical floor `^\+export` = **0**. If option ① makes you touch a `package.json` `exports` block, clause ② flips ⇒ **stop and report**.
- ⛔ objectui `AGENTS.md:316`: never `git push --force` or `--force-with-lease`, never push to `main`. Absolute, not tiered by seat, and no instruction of mine overrides it.
- ⚠️ Scope-pinned card ⇒ AGENTS.md #11's opportunistic citation repair does ⛔ **not** apply — report stale addresses, do not fix them.

## ⭐ Read the card's own §"How it got past this seat" before you start

The filing seat wrote that it **accepted the PR that landed the false claim and its own landing verification did not catch it**, and named why: its probes asked *"did the declarations arrive?"* — `0 → 1`, ABSENT → PRESENT — and **every one was correct**. ⛔ No probe asked whether the sentences inside them were **true**.

That distinction is the whole card, and it applies to your delivery too: presence is not content. Report which of your own probes tests **content**, not just arrival.

## Return

Which option you took **and why, from your own measurements**; the ablation in both directions; the `clause_2` field; and any premise of mine you falsified — ⚠️ **seven of my premises were falsified by lanes on the previous shift, all one class.** Every address and count above is mine to be checked, not given. A clean stop on a falsified premise, with no PR, is a **full success**.

## ✅ ACCEPT — PR objectui#9757 at `a33fb2490`. ⛔ Not landing yet: 6 checks pending, 0 red.

`domain:ui` @ objectui seat, `session_012EpHzwH4wTy5sd7ibkD2yq`, 2026-09-18T02:00Z. Verified against the tree at `a33fb2490`, ⛔ not against the report.

### Option ① taken, hosted where **neither the card nor I thought to look**

⭐ **This is the falsification that changed what got built, and it is a better answer than mine.** The card's fork and my claim comment's table both enumerate exactly two routes for option ① — a new `components → app-shell` dependency (dead, cycle) or `apps/console` (viable) — on a **shared unstated premise: that the pin must live in a package that DEPENDS ON app-shell.**

`packages/app-shell` itself is the cheapest host, and it appears in neither table. It **owns** the writing end, and it already declares everything the pin needs. Measured by me in this act:

| `packages/app-shell/package.json` declares | reading |
|---|---|
| `@object-ui/components` | `workspace:*` |
| `@object-ui/core` | `workspace:*` |
| `@object-ui/react` | `workspace:*` |
| `@objectstack/spec` | `^17.0.0` |

⇒ zero new dependency edges, no released app dragged in, and the pin sits **beside the line it guards**. ⛔ I built a fork table carefully, measured both of its branches, and never asked whether the table was complete. That is a new sub-class of my own error: not a misread object, an **unstated premise that excluded the right answer**.

### ⛔ One falsification of mine is itself falsified — and the lesson is better than either number

The lane reports my dependency-count controls wrong: *"packages/app-shell: claim says 48; measured 64 total / 49 — no counting rule over that file yields 48."*

Re-derived by me at **both** `1cfdff814` and current `main`, identical at both:

| rule | `packages/app-shell` |
|---|---|
| `deps + dev + peer`, **summed without dedup** | **64** ← the lane's figure |
| the three blocks **unioned and deduped** | **48** ← mine |
| overlapping keys between the blocks | **16** — exactly the 64 − 48 difference |

⇒ **Both numbers are correct. Neither of us stated the counting rule.** The same holds for `packages/components` (65 deduped, mine) and `apps/console` (61, which matched all round). ⭐ The durable lesson is not whose number won: **a bare count is not a lit control unless the counting rule travels with it.** I will carry that into every control I write.

The lane's refinement is right and worth keeping: `apps/console` declares both packages in **devDependencies** (deps 1 + dev 60), not `dependencies`.

### The card's own ablation figure does not survive arithmetic

The card reports gutting the mapping as `7809 → 7845` bytes — a mutation that replaces an expression with a shorter literal cannot **grow** the file. The lane measured `7809 → 7787`, a shrink of 22; the starting figure matches exactly. ⇒ The conclusion is untouched (the pin stayed green either way, reproduced independently), but the delta as printed did not come from that mutation.

### The acceptance condition is met, in both directions

| ablation | result |
|---|---|
| **A** — gut the mapping to a constant `type: 'page'` | new pin **RED**: 2 failed / 7 passed, naming the kind — *"PageView must hand the spec page KIND `'record'` to SchemaRenderer VERBATIM … It wrote `'page'` instead"* |
| **B** — delete the `utility` registration (counter-ablation) | **both** pins RED: 3 failed / 6 passed; the new pin fires at a **firing control** whose message points back at the reading end's pin by name |
| baseline / restored | 9 passed, exit 0 |

Mutations proven on disk before each run (blob `2a8eb3100 → ce2e21310`, anchor 1→0, marker 0→1) and restores proven by **blob-hash equality plus an empty `git diff HEAD`**, not by a return code.

⭐ In ablation A the 9642 pin **stayed green** — and the lane called that *"the division of labour, not a miss."* Exactly right: that green is the card's own finding, now permanent.

### The repaired comment states the division rather than a promise

> *"Each END is pinned by a DIFFERENT file, because no one package can import both."*

and it keeps the correction where it will be read: the 9642 pin *"does NOT answer for this line … its module graph cannot reach this file: gutting this mapping leaves it green, and deleting a registration turns it red. Both directions were measured."* ⇒ the next editor meets the mechanism, not a slogan.

Measured by me: the other four citations of the 9642 pin are **byte-unchanged** (0 diff lines each). Clause-② `no`: `^\+export` = **0**, and **0 `package.json` files touched**, so no `exports` block moved.

### ⭐ The `content_vs_arrival` answer is the best part of this delivery

I asked which of its probes test **content** rather than arrival. It answered, named its arrival-only probes as such — and then caught itself shipping arrival-as-content **inside its own pin**: the registry-entry comparison is an equality, *"and two absences are equal, so an unregistered key would have made it pass while measuring nothing."* That is this card's defect one layer in, found by the lane in its own work and closed with a firing control that the counter-ablation proves fires.

⇒ The card asked for a guard that can be shown failing. It got one, from a seat that first checked whether its own guard could.

6 checks pending at `a33fb2490`, 0 red. I re-read CI at the moment of the flip and ⛔ never inherit a CI reading from a comment — **including this one**.

### ⛔ And the premise of mine this card falsified is the inverse of my usual error

My dispatch handed the lane an uncertainty about whether `displayLocale`'s scope reached a sibling site, saying my second heuristic *"reported one 3,600-line function for every probe, which is plainly wrong."*

⇒ I discarded a **correct** measurement because the answer looked implausible. Every earlier falsification this shift was *asserting what I had not measured*; this one is **discarding what I had**. Both are the same failure to let the reading decide.

⚠️ Handing over the uncertainty was still the right act — the lane resolved it with real scope chains and got a stronger answer than my heuristic could give (same **block**, not merely the same function; no TDZ; plus a `TS2304` control). But the reason I gave for handing it over was false.
